items.title: Minecraft system requirements raised for the first time in 17 years — Microsoft now recommends 16GB of RAM and a 2020s or newer CPU to run the Java Edition
items.summary: Microsoft is increasing the minimum and recommended system requirements for Minecraft for the first time, 17 years after it launched. Although the system upgrade is quite reasonable and the hardware falls squarely within the most popular components in the most recent Steam Hardware Survey, those playing with a bare-minimum PC would have to upgrade their systems.

items.title_bilingual: Minecraft system requirements raised for the first time in 17 years — Microsoft now recommends 16GB of RAM and a 2020s or newer CPU to run the Java Edition
items.summary_zh: 在 Minecraft 推出 17 年后，微软首次提高了 Minecraft 的最低和推荐系统要求。尽管系统升级相当合理，并且硬件完全属于最近 Steam 硬件调查中最受欢迎的组件，但那些使用最低限度 PC 玩游戏的人还是必须升级他们的系统。
